messages:
maria-ops: Quick postmortem follow-up from the cross-region DNS/LB flapping last night. Root cause looks like a cascade: regional LB health check flapped -> clients re-resolve aggressively -> registrar TTL + route churn amplified retries. Posting action items, owners, and timelines. Please ack and add any missed tasks.

devon-sre: I'll capture the metrics + replay traces in the incident doc. Noted a consistent spike in application-level retry_count and SYN retransmits at 23:12 UTC. Putting a short timeline in the doc: initial LB failure 23:09 -> registrar updates 23:11 -> client re-resolve storm 23:12-23:20.

ashok-net: I can own the TTL/registrar side. Proposed immediate mitigation: lower authoritative TTL from 300 -> 60 in two canary regions, then roll the rest if stable. Will open a change PR with staged windows and rollback plan. ETA: change drafted by EOD, rollout tomorrow morning.

lee-eng: I'll take the routing-shadow rule fix. Found a legacy shadow rule in infra repo that overwrote preferred egress when LB was marked degraded. Small config patch & unit test. PR link (will add once up). Plan: quick canary deploy to us-west, monitor 1h.

paul-net: I'll own registrar contact & emergency escalation. Need approval to request a TTL override from registrar and to bump rate limits on their side if required. Also will get a postmortem note to registrar ops.

maria-ops: Action list so far:
- TTL canary change (owner: ashok-net) - ETA: draft EOD
- Routing-shadow config patch (owner: lee-eng) - ETA: PR in next 4hrs
- Registrar escalation & record rotation plan (owner: paul-net) - ETA: initial contact within 2hrs
- Metrics + traces replay (owner: devon-sre) - ETA: morning, include seq logs
- Follow-up postmortem doc update (owner: maria-ops) - ETA: tomorrow EOD

oncall-bot: Created incident-tracker task: https://tracker.redwood.internal/INC-5123 "DNS cascade / client re-resolve storm" assigned to incident-followup.

devon-sre: From the replay, looks like many clients retried with exponential backoff disabled (old lib). Short-term mitigation: add client-side jitter and a small client retry cap via config. Not an infra-only fix — product teams need a patch.

lee-eng: tagging @product-api to coordinate client patch. @paul-net please confirm whether we can do TTL reduction without affecting certificate rotation windows.

paul-net: Certificate rotation not impacted by short TTL changes for A records. If we touch CNAMEs with cert-managed hostnames, call it out. For A records lowering TTL is fine.

ashok-net: Will include a one-line runbook for rollback (set TTL back to 300 + propagation wait) and a quick health-check query: ``dig +short service.api.redwood.internal A`` and check for >90% stable answers across regions.

maria-ops: Recurring incident note: This is the 3rd DNS-backoff pattern in 6 months. We should add a long-term item: registrar provider comparison + automatic failover policy that avoids client-side re-resolve storms.

devon-sre: Agreed. Long-term work: "registrar hardening + client backoff enforcement". Recommend we schedule a 2-week spike to prototype a coordinated backoff/route-staggering mechanism.

lee-eng: sgtm. I'll write a short RFC and circulate. Includes: canonical routing precedence, avoid shadow rules, and a library for safe re-resolve semantics.

maria-ops: Please ack your assigned items in this thread. We'll run a 15m sync at 11:00 to confirm progress.

ashok-net: ack.

lee-eng: ack. PR draft up in 30m.

paul-net: ack, contacting registrar now.

devon-sre: ack, replay notes will be in the incident doc.

maria-ops: Thanks all. I'll update the incident tracker with these owners & ETAs. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
